anchor.statement: Lemma A.9. Let c > 0, let j be a fixed nonnegative integer, and let b(u, η ) be smooth for 0 ≤ u ≤ δ 0 and for η in a compact interval K. There exists a coefficient B such that, for 0 < δ ≤ δ 0 , ∫︂ δ 0 e −c/u2 u −j b(u, η )du = 1 2 e −c/ δ 2 δ 3−j B( δ , η ). (A.47)

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: exists_factor_on_rectangle states, for c > 0, j ∈ ℕ, a compact parameter set K in a finite-dimensional space and b smooth on an open neighbourhood of K × [0, δ0], that there is a smooth B with ∫_0^δ e^{−c/u²} u^{−j} b du = (1/2) e^{−c/δ²} δ^{3−j} B(δ, η) for 0 < δ ≤ δ0, B(0, η) = b(0, η)/c, and every fixed-order jet of B bounded on K × [0, δ0]. Smoothness on a neighbourhood of the closed rectangle is the standard reading of 'smooth for 0 ≤ u ≤ δ0'.

conclusion.text:
ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) B ∧
  (∀ p ∈ K, B (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / c) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ K,
        ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 δ₀,
          ∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..δ, Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j * b (p, u) =
            1 / 2 * Real.exp (-c / δ ^ 2) * δ ^ (3 - ↑j) * B (p, δ)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Icc 0 δ₀, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n B (p, δ)‖ ≤ C

exact.text:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K : Set E},
  IsCompact K →
    ∀ {δ₀ c : ℝ},
      0 < δ₀ →
        0 < c →
          ∀ (j : ℕ) {U : Set (E × ℝ)},
            IsOpen U →
              K ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 δ₀ ⊆ U →
                ∀ {b : E × ℝ → ℝ},
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) b U →
                    ∃ (B : E × ℝ → ℝ),
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) B ∧
                        (∀ p ∈ K, B (p, 0) = b (p, 0) / c) ∧
                          (∀ p ∈ K,
                              ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 δ₀,
                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..δ, Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j * b (p, u) =
                                  1 / 2 * Real.exp (-c / δ ^ 2) * δ ^ (3 - ↑j) * B (p, δ)) ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Icc 0 δ₀, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n B (p, δ)‖ ≤ C

conclusion.text: ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b' ∧ Set.EqOn b' b K

exact.text:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {K U : Set E},
  IsCompact K →
    IsOpen U → K ⊆ U → ∀ {b : E → ℝ}, ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) b U → ∃ (b' : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) b' ∧ Set.EqOn b' b K
